frames.frame: from [A] to [B]（无冠词 from…to… 循环/范围短语）
frames.gloss: 名词不带冠词地夹在 from 与 to 之间，表示逐个遍历、空间范围或状态递进。
frames.pattern_notes:
槽位 [A]/[B] 为光杆单数名词或形容词，不能加冠词或换 a/one：varies from culture to culture（因文化而异）、narrow from front to back（前后方向）。
查表价值在于整存整取一类同构短语（from door to door / from place to place / from bad to worse），误读点正是冠词缺席：学习者易读成 from a culture to another 或在 the injured areas 之类的复数干扰后卡住。
其中 go from bad to worse 是该框架的成语化极端（形容词槽位，表每况愈下）。

examples.s: Just like spoken language, body language varies from culture to culture.
Finally, the statue is quite narrow from front to back—by proportion much narrower than most people are in real life.
Infer character traits and emotions May 1916 We have been struggling for days, but things on Elephant Island are going from bad to worse.

frames.frame: make sure (that) [小句]（变体：be sure to [V]）
frames.gloss: 确保/务必：make sure 后接 that 小句（that 可省），be sure to 后接动词原形。
frames.pattern_notes:
两种骨架分工固定：make sure [小句] 说"确保某事成立"；be sure to [V] 用于叮嘱"务必去做"，不可互换（make sure to 也存在但语感不同，教材中成对出现的是这两型）。
误读点在 make sure 后的 that 省略：made sure that he was fine 可见 that，Make sure your home is equipped 则省略，学习者易把省略 that 的小句误当新主句。

examples.s: The doctors checked Zhang and made sure that he was fine.
• Make sure your home is equipped with fire extinguishers.
Visitors have to bring in their own food and drink, and then be sure to carry out all their waste when they leave.

frames.frame: [V-ing 短语（含宾语/状语）] + 单数谓语（动名词作主语）
frames.gloss: 把一个行为整体名词化充当主语，谓语动词用单数。
frames.pattern_notes:
槽位是"V-ing + 自己的宾语和状语"的整个短语，之后直接接单数谓语（is/can be/helps 等）。
误读点为花园路径：Applying oil to the injured areas is… 中复数名词 areas 紧邻单数动词 is，学习者容易在一致关系上读卡；产出时也常误写 *Apply oil… is a bad idea。
本批三例分别接 can be / is / helps，覆盖情态、系词、实义动词三类谓语。

examples.s: Using this break wisely can be very beneficial.
Applying oil to the injured areas is a bad idea, as it will keep the heat in the wounds and may cause infection.
Listening to English radio programmes helps me get used to how fast native speakers talk.

frames.frame: [动词/复杂介词] + 介词 + wh-词 + [小句]
frames.gloss: 介词后面直接跟 how/what/which 等引导的宾语从句（陈述语序），不退化为名词。
frames.pattern_notes:
骨架为 V + prep + wh-小句：learn about how…、decide on which…、according to how…，介词不因从句而删除。
与已有框架"介词+which/whom 从句"（关系从句）同形不同质：decide on which two sailors Shackleton chose 中 which two sailors 是疑问限定词带内嵌疑问句（陈述语序），学习者极易与关系从句混淆而读错语序。
误读点二在切分：learn about how the Red Cross was founded 易被切成 about 聚合到前文或把 how 后当成疑问倒装。

examples.s: learn about how the Red Cross was founded and what it does.
EXAMPLE A: We have to decide on which two sailors Shackleton chose for his rescue team.
Many Chinese characters symbolise their meanings, unlike English words which are spelt out according to how they sound.

candidates.note: What other [NP] do you [V]…?：本批 3 例（S08038、S01744、S02981）重复达标，但均为教材读前/读后讨论题，语域判据存疑（疑为提问模板）；且学习者基本一眼读懂，误读判据弱，故不入 frames。

example.s: What other kinds of ICH do you know about?

candidates.note: How often do you [V]…?：2 例（J03183、J03383）重复达标，但出自教材健康调查操练，语域判据存疑；wh-疑问句构成本身属基础语法，无查表优势。

example.s: How oft en do you go to the movies?

candidates.note: 疑问/不定代词 + else（Who else…、Everyone else…）：2 例（S03762、J03040）重复达标，但 else 位置属早期教学内容，误读判据弱，拿不准。

example.s: Everyone else was in a T-shirt and jeans.

candidates.note: be of + 形容词 + 抽象名词（= be + 形容词）：误读与查表判据均成立，但本批仅 1 例，重复不足。

example.s: That writing system was of great importance in uniting the Chinese people and culture.

candidates.note: no more than + 数量（仅仅/至多，强调少）：判据均成立，仅 1 例。

example.s: Qingming Shang He Tu is no more than 24 cm wide and 520 cm long.

candidates.note: the + 最高级 + (that) there is（现存的极致评价结构，there is 作定语）：解析难度高（学习者会把 there is 当主句），仅 1 例。

example.s: ” Bless Frank Wild, the kindest man there is after our leader, Ernest Shackleton.

candidates.note: [NP], if [V-ed/adj], [主句]：条件状语从句省略主语与 be（if left unchecked = if they are left unchecked），学习者常误问"谁 left"；仅 1 例。

example.s: These bad habits, if left unchecked, could lead to more serious ones when they become adults.

candidates.note: feel like + 小句（觉得好像，非"想要"义）：误读判据成立（与 would like 义混淆），仅 1 例。

example.s: I felt like I was on some distant planet, and was both amazed and rather scared.

candidates.note: but what about [NP]?（反问转移话题框架）：口语自然，仅 1 例。

example.s: Jack: Yes, but what about the long waiting time to get movie tickets?

candidates.note: [礼貌道歉语], but [问句]（I beg your pardon, but… / Excuse me, but…）：真实口语套语框架，但本批仅此 1 个 id（功能性语言框内同 id 含 3 个套语），不同句重复不足，且疑属教材功能句型框，语域判据拿不准。

example.s: • The part of Moscow • Place for parades, concerts, and even The Forbidden City I beg your pardon, but … Forgive me for asking, but … Excuse me, but what is …?

candidates.note: 句尾 , as [小句]（表原因，非"当…时"非"像"）：as 三义辨析是真实误读点，本批仅 1 例明确表原因。

example.s: Applying oil to the injured areas is a bad idea, as it will keep the heat in the wounds and may cause infection.

candidates.note: unlike [A], [B] / [A] …, unlike [B]（对比框架）：判据基本成立，仅 1 例。

example.s: Many Chinese characters symbolise their meanings, unlike English words which are spelt out according to how they sound.

candidates.note: To [V]…, [主句]（句首目的不定式）：仅 1 例，且目的不定式接近语法范畴，拿不准骨架判据。

example.s: Text 2 To truly understand our planet, we must explore the oceans which cover most of it.

candidates.note: those who [小句]（凡…之人）：本批仅 1 例（all those who died）。

example.s: Snow began by marking on a map the exact places where all those who died had lived.

candidates.note: You can never imagine how [小句]（修辞性强调开场）：误读风险低（表层直读即懂），仅 1 例。

example.s: Y ou can never imagine how difficult the road to success is.

candidates.note: [A], while [B]（对比连词 while）：真实框架但本批仅 1 例。

example.s: Most students favour the plan, while their teachers are not in favour of it.

candidates.note: Why [小句] is that [B]（假拟分裂的 why-主语变体，已有框架只登记了 What-型）：仅 1 例且原句本身可疑，暂记变体线索。

example.s: Why different crops are grown is that they put important minerals back into the ground, making it ready for the next batch of crops.

candidates.note: help + [O] + (to) [V]（helps me get used to… 等）：本批 5+ 例重复充足，但属使役/带动词范畴，按判据 1（纯语法范畴不报）排除，仅记录备查。

example.s: This knowledge, people argue, helps customers make the best choices for themselves and their families.

candidates.note: make it + adj + for [sb] + to [V]（形式宾语外置）：本批 1 例，且属不定式外置，判据 1 明确排除，仅记录备查。

example.s: The damage caused by the tsunami is making it difficult for rescue workers to help the survivors.
